_help: Per-control notes and visuals for the control sheet (SPEC-70 DEV-029). Keys are action paths (Map/Action, hover a card to see it). Fields: label, note, probes (scenario probe names, or {name, label, unit, digits, min, max, values}), visual (a name in visuals.js) and visualProbe. Save and refresh the browser; no recompile.

Global/DevConsole.note: Type `controls` to open this sheet, `controls close` to stop it.
